author: Karl Rock
description:
Is this the best Nihari in the world? In this food vlog from Karachi, Pakistan, I visit the legendary Zahid Nihari, one of the most famous Nihari restaurants in the country. Locals say this place serves the best Nihari in Karachi, and it has even won international awards. Some fans love it so much that the restaurant reportedly cans its Nihari so people can take it overseas.

I’ve eaten Nihari in Pakistan, India, and even London, so today I’m putting Zahid Nihari to the test to see if it really lives up to the hype.

Inside the restaurant, we take a look at how this iconic dish is served and the different styles available - including beef Nihari, brain Nihari, and bone marrow Nihari. Watching the chefs prepare the dish and mix everything together is part of the experience before sitting down to taste one of Pakistan’s most famous foods.
